# TASK-151 — Skill audit

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Skill best practices (2026-10-01)

## Intent

Make those rules checkable instead of remembered. `shared/skill-audit.ts` returns findings with a severity (errors fail `pnpm skills:check`, CI and the tests; warnings are advice). It applies to this repository's skills and to every skill SDD Studio generates. Testing on Haiku, Sonnet and Opus and writing three evaluations per skill are not automatable here and stay in the backlog.

## What it delivers

Tests: `tests/skill-audit.test.ts` (28). `pnpm skills:check --strict` passes; pointed at third-party skills it finds real problems. The CI step has not run on GitHub.
